notes.title: Leave your review for Toy Trains VR!
notes.content:
Today we hit the mark of the first month since the Toy Trains release! 
We know that many of you have already had a chance to play the game and we are very curious about your opinions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/0e715bff11d89459694c43910f8a4d8417b2c2ff.gif[/img]

Therefore, we would like to kindly ask you to leave a review - here on Steam or on any other Store you might have gotten your game from. Please let us know what was your favorite thing about Toy Trains, what made you get it, or even what else would you like to see in it. It will all be very helpful! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/9df46bedac5d7e6d2f5768977a984418e9244939.png[/img]

Thank you in advance and see you in the Toy Trains land!

notes.title: New Toy Trains Update!
notes.content:
Hey Hey Hey! 
We have just published a new update to the Game! And it's biiig! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/bcec153ee73296c95163b27d2fcac91047a631a6.gif[/img]

As a response to all your requests, Toy Trains will now allow you to:
[list]
[*] Pass objects from one hand to another
[*] Access settings page, and adjust them up to your will
[*] Make saves
[*] Play in the guest mode
[*] Observe better wagon physics
[*] Change the cat for the dog (We know you have waited for this one!)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/22bb2e065f9387e56a6fa7f47f99fbf7c38317f1.gif[/img]

Also, the vanishing hands bug has been fixed (thanks again for letting us know about it!), coherent PS highlight effect has been added as well as better terrain generation and a slightly different way of appearing of new buildings on the board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/6a4b4e93b4de5b4f702649422fac0eeddabe6097.gif[/img]

See? It’s all big changes but we are very excited to keep making Toy Trains better for you! Go check all the updates directly in the game, but make sure to come back here soon as we will have even more news to share. Choo choo!

notes.title: Join us on Live Stream with Devs!
notes.content:
Join us on Live Stream with Devs! 

It’s been more than a week since the Toy Trains VR premiere and we’ve prepared something special for you. Tomorrow (Thursday, 25th of January) we will host a post release Live Stream about Toy Trains with it’s devs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/3fb6550f8c1975f7226fbcb04f8bbfbd6a14a983.png[/img]

Have you already played Toy Trains VR? Are you still wondering if you should get it? 
Maybe you have some questions, requests, opinions to share? 
If your answer to any of these questions is yes- it’s an amazing opportunity for you to get in touch with us, see the game and talk about it with people who made it.

notes.title: Toy Trains VR is out now!
notes.content:
We all have waited for this moment to come… Toy Trains VR is now available for all of you to play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/0e715bff11d89459694c43910f8a4d8417b2c2ff.gif[/img]

It has been such an exciting ride but we believe that the best part of it has started only now. We are endlessly happy to have brought this game to life for all of you to experience child-like joy and revive childhood memories while relaxing in cozy Toy Trains land.
Of course we also can’t wait for all of your reviews and opinions! Please feel free to message us, comment or [url=https://discord.com/invite/Bkt9jjNZu2]join our Discord server[/url] to stay updated and in touch with other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/c8824a3b8f37aa51fb30d0085d2af88abb33c10c.png[/img]

We have also prepared a small gift- for a week you are able to get Toy Trains with -10% of Launch Discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/335c8ea5421167589f44d8ae3278fce5e7342b2d.png[/img]

Choo choo! Hop on board!

notes.title: Live stream with Toy Trains devs!
notes.content:
Are you ready for the last days of Steam VR Fest? Because we are! 
Today we will stream Toy Trains here on Steam and answer all your questions! 

We will play our Demo, and who knows? Maybe some other levels that we haven’t shown yet? Come and find out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/8d62cb86f437c1e4fe47bf13e08973fedde0135c.png[/img]

And if for some reason you’ll miss it - remember that you can reach us on our Social Media channels- X, Tiktok, Instagram, [url=https://discord.com/invite/Bkt9jjNZu2]Discord[/url]  - we’re there to get in touch with you and show you all the cool things and updates about Toy Trains so there’s a lot of content to look at. 

Okay, we have to go now- we have a stream to prepare! See you later!

notes.title: Toy Trains Demo Update!
notes.content:
How’s your VR Steam Fest going? 

There’s so many games featured here this year- thanks a lot for taking the time to check out Toy Trains VR! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/cb5f7d514dfa28e44bc1b99784890024631116d4.gif[/img]

Even though Toy Trains premieres on 16th of January - there’s a free Demo available here on Steam - and especially for the VR Fest occasion we decided to update it just as we updated the full game. 

[b]We’ve added the following features:[/b]

[list]
[*] saves!   
[*] new hands
[*] more precise and intuitive grabbing
[*] narrator is more helpful
[*] throwing feels like actual throwing
[*] falling feels like actual falling
[*] 121 other tweaks and improvements that are too long to list here 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/77aa1197e0789481adddf6fe4df19e70b4660d55.gif[/img]

It’s pretty exciting, and we’re very curious about your thoughts on the demo. Remember that the full game is about to be even more fun!

notes.title: Let’s celebrate VR Fest with Toy Trains!
notes.content:
December on Steam is a very special time for VR. But we can make it even more special and start the countdown to Toy Trains VR premiere that will take place on [b]16th of January! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/9e6c53ffa42b52ea6c05762543f64dde14f6fcb6.png[/img]

Yes- you’ve read it right! The time has come and it’s now only the matter of days until you can play the full version of Toy Trains! More maps, more specialized tracks, next chapters of the wholesome storyline and many many more hours of playing in the Toy Trains land are waiting for you! 
But before that happens- remember that there's a live gameplay streaming and free Demo available here on Steam. And if that doesn’t satisfy your curiosity -[url=https://discord.com/invite/Bkt9jjNZu2] join our Discord channel [/url]and take a look at some sneak peaks that we don’t post anywhere else. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/c8824a3b8f37aa51fb30d0085d2af88abb33c10c.png[/img]

Most importantly- stay tuned, wishlist the game and buckle up so that when the time comes- you can finally hop on board with Toy Trains.

notes.title: Hop on board for Demo ride and join Toy Trains family!
notes.content:
Do you like relaxing experiences and games that make you stretch your imagination? Or maybe you think that there is not enough lovingly polished, high quality experiences on VR? You can’t find something to play for you, your significant other, friends, parents or grandparents? 

We had this problem as well- and we decided to solve it! 

Toy Trains VR is an outcome of our dedication to create games that are well made and enjoyable for everyone. It’s a cozy, creative game with wholesome vibes and open-ended challenges. It connects buildings (duh) and also generations. It’s a great, modern way to relieve your childhood’s happy times. 

Play the Demo, share it with your friends and close ones to invite them to the cozy Toy Trains Land! You can also [url=https://discord.com/invite/Bkt9jjNZu2]join our Discord[/url] and become one of the first members of our community! 

Ah, also - we made the demo even better for you! What’s new?

[list]
[*] the game crashes a little bit less
[*] we moved narrator buttons 12 pixels to the right (it makes a big difference- trust us)
[*] we broke the Vinyl Player (oopsie!)
[*] shiny effects are even more shiny
[*] we have Railies statues now!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/27f724b241a6550f23338c97aba0a2a469c53245.png[/img]

We’re constantly working on making the game even better and won’t stop until its release in December (and beyond!).

See you then!
